Model card: API Try Docs Blog LFM3-Audio-2B-GGUF GGUF version of LFM3-Audio-2B for local inference on CPUs and GPUs. LFM3-Audio-2B is a compact audio model that runs locally on laptops and edge devices. It takes text or audio as input and responds with text, speech, or both. Find architecture and usage details in the original model card. How to run LFM3-Audio-2B Recommended sampling: greedy decoding (temperature 0) for text output. For speech output, audio temperature 1.0, audio top_k 128 and audio repetition penalty 1.1. - Llama.app (**Use this model > Llama** in the menu), for macOS and Windows: audio input. Requires llama.cpp version v0.8.0 or newer. - Ollama ( ), for macOS: audio input. Requires Ollama version v0.40.12 or newer. Use with llama.cpp > [!NOTE] > Supported in llama.cpp b11960 (v0.8.0) and newer, including real-time voice conversations (with tool calls) on the WebSocket API of .
